description: Industrial Surface Inspection Datasets is an external data catalogue linking to multiple resources. This record describes the catalogue inventory, not a single dataset. Saved infrastructure members include Xi’an bridge crack images for DBCC; SDNET2018 labelled concrete crack images from bridge decks, walls and pavements; CrackForest annotated road-crack images. The catalogue publisher identity is not established separately in this link record. The catalogue link comes from saved parent-discovery metadata and its exact seed-to-parent evidence. Coverage here is limited to the individually listed infrastructure resources; the external inventory can also contain other subjects or resource types. Access is through the public catalogue page recorded below. Member formats, licence terms, cost and access requirements vary and must be checked on each source record; no catalogue-wide permission is inferred. The catalogue supports discovery of inputs for infrastructure simulation where individual member metadata establishes that role. Related records are existing members, not an exhaustive inventory. Caveats: no fresh source visit was made for this addition. Current links, historical versions and complete member coverage remain unverified. No dataset files were downloaded.
